messages:
sam: Heads-up — I'm planning a terraform change to add an HPA for `inference-pool` to allow short burst scaling for inference jobs. Need a quick check on metrics wiring + secrets before I open the PR. Plan snippet below. cc @maria @jen

maria: quick question — is this going to use the prometheus adapter in-cluster or the external metrics endpoint? if it's adapter, VPA could fight us if resource targets change.

sam: It'll use the prometheus adapter (external metrics API) -> metric name `queue_length_per_replica`. VPA only targets resource requests/limits, we plan to keep those stable and let HPA scale on the queue metric.

jen: can you paste the HPA spec you're planning? also need to ensure the prometheus-adapter RBAC includes the serviceAccount used by the HPA (namespace is `inference`).

sam: sure — minimal HPA snippet I'm adding via terraform kubernetes_manifest:```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2beta2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: inference-pool-hpa
  namespace: inference
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: inference-pool
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 20
  metrics:
  - type: External
    external:
      metric:
        name: queue_length_per_replica
      target:
        type: AverageValue
        averageValue: "5"
```

arthur: couple notes: (1) Karpenter provisioner needs awsNodeTemplate labels to be compatible with pods (taints/ttl). If pods have nodeAffinity we'll need matching labels on provisioner. (2) consider a nodeSelector label `pool=inference` so we can give those instances different spot fallback rules.

paul: Also need to wire Prometheus creds — the adapter queries Prom endpoint via a read-only token stored in Vault: `secret/data/infra/monitoring/prom-adapter`. The terraform change must ensure Vault secret exists (or at least the path) and IAM/KMS keys are referenced.

sam: terraform snippet for secret (will be in the same PR):```hcl
resource "vault_generic_secret" "prom_adapter" {
  path = "secret/data/infra/monitoring/prom-adapter"
  data_json = jsonencode({
    token = var.prometheus_adapter_token
  })
}
# then kubernetes secret rendered via vault-k8s or external sync
```

jen: make sure the sync controller has the right rolebinding in `inference` namespace. we've seen races where HPA loads before secret sync and metrics queries 401 -> crashloop. Could add a small init job to wait for secret or use `kubectl rollout restart` after secret sync.

sam: good call. I'll add a `local-exec` null_resource that waits for the k8s secret to exist before applying the HPA:```hcl
resource "null_resource" "wait_secret" {
  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = "bash -c 'until kubectl get secret prom-adapter -n inference; do sleep 2; done'"
  }
  triggers = { secret_version = vault_generic_secret.prom_adapter.data_json }
}
```

oncall: FYI — if this lands in staging, I'll run a small traffic canary (5min) during off-peak. ping me 15m before apply. :white_check_mark:

devops-bot: terraform plan queued — no destructive changes detected for these resources. Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/plan/8421 (blocked until PR opened).

maria: one more: VPA + HPA interplay — ensure we set `updateMode: "Off"` for VPA in the inference namespace for this rollout, otherwise VPA may adjust requests and HPA thresholds become unpredictable.

sam: noted — will set VPA updateMode to Off in staging for the canary. I'll open the PR in ~30m. tagging @jen and @arthur for review ping when it's up.

jen: ok, I'll review and check RBAC + rolebindings. if you can include a `kubectl patch` snippet to restart deployment post-secret sync that speeds up the canary, that'd help.

arthur: also add a comment in the provisioner terraform explaining the `pool=inference` label mapping to avoid accidental deletions later. small docs bit goes a long way.

sam: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
